title: Nice Nutty Dutch Beef Skewers
description: Sweet and juicy Dutch dish featuring ground nut oil, perfect for a date night, and sugar-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the grill to medium-high heat, about 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, combine the ground beef, chopped onion, minced garlic, salt, black pepper, and paprika, mixing well with your hands until just combined.
Thread small balls of the beef mixture onto the bamboo skewers, leaving a small space between each ball.
Brush the skewers with ground nut oil on all sides.
Place the skewers on the grill and cook for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally, until the beef is cooked through and slightly charred.
Remove the skewers from the grill and let rest for 2-3 minutes before serving.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with fresh parsley or thyme if desired.
